title: Canonical flat base-change resolution construction
statement: For a square of schemes with f:X→S and flat g:S′→S, define Q=f_*t composed with the canonical pushforward-square comparison, C as the termwise adjoint of Q, and Beta=g^* of the resolution comparison, the inverse exact-pullback homology comparison, H^p(C), and the inverse target resolution comparison. For compatible restricted-resolution choices D define sourceClass and targetClass by resolutionSectionClass followed by the inverse resolution comparison, exactly as in the parent statement. These are actual constructions, without postponed data. [def-weil-pbc-flat-base-change-open-choices] [def-pc-module-pullback] [lem-weil-pbc-flat-module-pullback-exact-pushforward-injective]

lean.statement:
def flatBaseChangeResolutionBeta {X S S' : Scheme.{uBC}} (f : X ⟶ S) (g : S' ⟶ S) [Flat g]
    {F : X.Modules} (I : InjectiveResolution F)
    (J : InjectiveResolution ((tensorPullback (pullback.snd g f)).obj F))
    (t : I.cocomplex ⟶
      ((pushforward (pullback.snd g f)).mapHomologicalComplex
        (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj J.cocomplex) (p : ℕ) :
    (tensorPullback g).obj (((pushforward f).rightDerived p).obj F) ⟶
      ((pushforward (pullback.fst g f)).rightDerived p).obj
        ((tensorPullback (pullback.snd g f)).obj F)
